metas.name: 1 · ★ 3.8 · 1997 · Operation Delta Force
metas.description: A team of military experts and scientists go after a terrorist group that has seized a deadly virus and is threatening to release it.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 3.5 · 1997 · Operation Delta Force 2: Mayday
metas.description: A ship captained by the father of the leader of Delta Force is taken hostage by terrorists. As might be expected the force is sent in to stop them.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.7 · 1998 · Operation Delta Force 3: Clear Target
metas.description: The anti-terrorist team Delta Force destroys a billion dollar cocaine stash, to the extreme displeasure of drug cartel leader Umberto Salvatore. To retaliate, he hijacks a stealth submarine and threatens to unleash a biological weapon with the power to kill everyone in New York City.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 3.8 · 1999 · Operation Delta Force 4: Deep Fault
metas.description: A four-men Delta Force team is trying, with the help of a female scientist, to stop a mad terrorist who wants to detonate nukes in order to cause a massive earthquake. The team is out-manned and out-gunned, but has nothing to lose.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 3.3 · 2000 · Operation Delta Force 5: Random Fire
metas.description: An elite task force is assigned to handle a Middle-Eastern terrorist mastermind who is using mind-control techniques to create an army of willing suicide bombers.
